verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own materials describe a built-in AI troubleshooting assistant that answers natural-language queries with device-specific answers [docs-11]. They also describe an AI note-taker (Session Insights) that summarizes each case [docs-12], and 'Tia, your AI agent' that predicts, prevents and fixes IT issues [docs-21]. Together these cover delegating real tasks to an in-product assistant, but the evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what actions Tia can autonomously execute, scope and limits of delegation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
